integrity: Transition tables, mathematical proof, and finite exhaustive checker are supplied. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The minimum total factor-state count of five is proved for two-letter complete deterministic automata and positivity language \(\{\varepsilon\}\cup a\{a,b\}^*\), not for arbitrary \(f\).
The product is synchronized to the designated state, even though that state is not a corner; the three-factor synchronization conjecture is not assessed.
A journal full text later than the freely available preprint was not directly compared; possible equivalent unpublished results remain a priority risk.
title: Minimal failure of \(f\)-corner inheritance under binary DFA products
